_doc: Elites (0.3.3): an existing monster plus one or more words, Diablo-style, using the player's own keyword vocabulary. The monster keeps its own behaviour; each word adds one trait. base applies to every elite. patrols and ley_waves say when they appear and how many words they roll. Numbers are first-pass, deliberately large; tune freely. Guardians, bosses, cast words (EXPLODING, SHOOTING) and learning a word from a defeated elite are later work (doc 15).
